task: Replace discrete Sunshower photo switching with a finger-following horizontal carousel, visible arrows/counter/thumbnails, and a synchronized swipeable zoom viewer.

identityBeforeWrite.method: Reused draft first synchronized in its only two differing source assets to fresh MAIN, renamed, then verified before feature write

scope.actualProductionReadback: Eight production contents exact: five existing changed, three added; 492 baseline files unchanged

vendor.name: photoswipe
vendor.evidenceSource: Official npm tarball integrity, exact vendor byte comparison, no installation scripts

implementation.inlineGallery: Native horizontal scroll container with CSS scroll-snap; images remain actual adjacent slides and touch is browser-owned. Main theme button-slider was evaluated but does not supply the complete requested interaction.
implementation.selection: Nearest visible slide drives the single selected thumbnail, roving tab index and counter. Pending arrow target supports repeated clicks. Ends clamp without wrapping. Thumbnail reveal scrolls only the thumbnail strip.
implementation.controls: 44px round previous/next arrows remain visible with disabled boundary state; counter and expand button. Fixed 4:5 frame contains the full image without cropping.
implementation.touch: touch-action:auto permits browser horizontal/vertical pan and pinch; no JS swipe-on-release substitution. Pointer tracking only suppresses accidental zoom click after movement. No claim of physical touch verification.
implementation.viewer: Local PhotoSwipe core dynamically imported on open, CSS scoped to Sunshower PDP inclusion. Same real media index; changes immediately synchronize page carousel. Visible touch arrows, counter, zoom/close, keyboard and focus management, safe-area positioning and reduced-motion settings. allowPanToNext:false keeps zoomed pan from changing photos. Closing preserves index and restores focus.
implementation.fallback: All slides are full-image anchor links. If dynamic module import fails, the selected full image opens via its actual URL. Photo load errors have NL/EN text.
implementation.preservation: Only gallery JS block, gallery/viewer CSS rules, gallery Liquid/CSS inclusion/old dialog removal and one photo_error key in each locale changed; purchase/configurator/accessory code unchanged.
implementation.regressionGuards: Late scrollend/fallback timers cannot erase a newer unarrived arrow intent; deliberate pointer input or horizontal wheel can cancel it. Scoped display:block preserves PhotoSwipe backdrop and placeholder against Dawn empty-div reset.
